value.rationale: A complete projective row-geometry trichotomy answers how a quantization grid affects probability of lifting a rank-one two-column input. It yields sharp N-dependent success probabilities and two different nondegenerate Poisson critical limits at identical entrywise noise variance, a concrete structural limitation of variance-only guidance in numerical quantization. Dependence across coordinates can eliminate rank restoration entirely.
